claims.claim_text: Architected governed multi-agent orchestration and GraphRAG grounding, establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across regulated client environments.
Aligned enterprise AI workflow adoption to CFO priorities, instrumenting consumption and renewal signals for enterprise AI platform adoption that sustained commercial expansion.
Built evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls that delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows in production.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse pipelines feeding vector retrieval services.
Converted bespoke client delivery into reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 to support commercialization of agentic AI capability.
